principle: each stage consumes only receipt-validated immutable workspaces from prior stages; no downstream stage may synthesize or repair missing human judgments

stages.inputs: one or more complete independent return stages: PRIMARY architecture, EXTERNAL U1 architecture, PREDICTOR review
stages.workspace_policy: new immutable output directory for each intake state

stages.prerequisite: PRIMARY U2+U6 reliability pass from S1
stages.human_action: source-review disagreements only; coder consensus cannot be overridden

stages.prerequisite: completed human adjudication return from S2 packet
U1 reliability pass when external validation is available

prerequisites: validated PRIMARY architecture-adjudication workspace from S3
intake workspace with predictor_return_status=COMPLETE and predictor_primary_complete=true
stages.gate: rerun canonical readiness; require zero primary human open gates and primary_model_assembly_ready=true

stages.prerequisite: validated composed V4 human-input workspace from S5
stages.gate: licensed U2/U6 assembly plus V4 estimability; analysis bundle must copy and hash-bind the source human-workspace receipt

stages.prerequisite: receipt-bound V4 analysis-input bundle from S6

automatic_outputs: temporal generality post-fit summary when the frozen generality gate is active
stages.rule: fit/postfit evidence may establish evidence eligibility only; publication reactivation still requires explicit human review
stages.receipt_chain_rule: reverify current fit contract -> each job receipt -> model source/compiled executable -> analysis wrapper/materialized Stan data -> every chain CSV and frozen chain metadata -> stansummary and recomputed diagnostics -> postfit summaries recomputed from chain draws -> analysis-input receipt -> copied human-workspace receipt -> licensed assembly/readout before eligibility

prohibitions: do not adjudicate PRIMARY architecture before U2 and U6 reliability pass
do not replace low-reliability groups; recode the same frozen groups after versioned codebook repair
do not edit rejected predictor receipts into acceptance without a new versioned evidence decision
do not compose V4 human inputs from unreceipted files
do not build V4 analysis inputs from mutable files outside a validated composed workspace
do not run CmdStan on wrappers not bound to one licensed assembly and copied human-workspace receipt
do not overwrite immutable intake, adjudication, composition, analysis-input, or fit workspaces
do not automatically retune CmdStan or reactivate publication after seeing fitted results
